question.prompt:
The coordinates of \(\bigtriangleup ABC\) are \(A(5, 7),\) \(B(11, 7),\) and \(C(3, y),\) with \(y > 7.\) The area of \(\bigtriangleup ABC\) is \(12.\) What is the value of \(y?\)

[Figure 1](figures/2024_AMC_8_Q11_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
Points \(A\) and \(B\) both have vertical coordinate \(7\), so \(AB\) is horizontal and has length \(11-5=6\). The corresponding height is the vertical distance from \(C(3,y)\) to \((3,7)\) on the line containing \(AB\). This is a valid height even though its foot lies to the left of \(A\).

Using triangle area equal to half the base times the height, the height \(h\) satisfies
\[
h=\frac{2\cdot12}{6}=4.
\]
Since \(y>7\), point \(C\) is four units above the horizontal line at height \(7\). Therefore \(y=7+4=\boxed{11}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
solutions.title: Read the base and height from coordinates
